content:
Overview

Gaithersburg is a city in MD with a population of 68,000. DC suburb with the NIST headquarters, biotech sector, and Rio entertainment center. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
